slip.use: when copied preset field +0x1c is zero, negated and stored to camera state +0x1a; otherwise +0x1a is cleared

semanticControl.label: Change View
semanticControl.ordinaryViewBranch: 0x0021f7cc..0x0021f868 branches on copied preset field +0x1c and passes one of the paired preset selectors to 0x002209c8
semanticControl.boundary: The executable independently proves the semantic Change View entry and the native preset-toggle branch. The runtime binding mask is indirect, so this evidence does not assign a browser button/key directly.

fixedStepLag.recurrence: error=target-value; velocity steps toward error by +0.001 or -0.001 per camera invocation, clamps to error to prevent overshoot, then value+=velocity
fixedStepLag.boundary: The helper has no dt input. Evidence establishes per-invocation recurrence, not an independent wall-clock rate.

resetAndRecenter.reset: ordinary update with controller +0x08 == 0 clears four per-player lag words at 0x017d41b0 + player*0x10 before returning
resetAndRecenter.trigger: controller +0x1c bit 0x400 installs 0x0021fb08 and zeroes controller +0x08
resetAndRecenter.timedState: for controller +0x08 < 0x40, camera state +0x16 is -0x8000 when preset field +0x1c is zero; from 0x40 through 0x7f it advances +0x200 per invocation; at >=0x80 context +0x28 bit 0x400 is cleared and the controller callback returns to 0x0021f540

numericTrace.behavior: clear context +0x28 bit 0x400 and restore ordinary callback

resetAndRecenter.boundary: No single native boolean equivalent to the browser chase-camera snap flag is proven.

obstruction.correction: 0x0021ef20 changes camera state +0x16 by -0x80 or +0x80, rebuilds via 0x00220458, and repeats while the selected scene collision query reports an invalid probe or raises corrected height, stopping at the signed-angle boundary
obstruction.provenance: gp-0x3e60 is the same selected collision-function slot already retained for PAL vehicle contact archaeology.

boundary: Static executable archaeology plus deterministic scalar traces. No production camera behavior is changed, no browser-only safety policy is claimed as native, and field names remain raw where consumers do not prove semantics.
